reasoning.test_accuracy: Primary metric for model effectiveness on unseen data
reasoning.overfitting_gap: Measures generalization: large gap indicates overfitting
reasoning.per_class_accuracy: Identifies which classes the model struggles with

reasoning.inference_time_single: Critical for real-time applications and user experience
reasoning.throughput: Determines scalability and batch processing capability
reasoning.total_flops_per_sample: Indicates computational complexity and hardware requirements

reasoning.total_parameters: Determines model capacity and minimum memory requirements
reasoning.peak_memory_mb: Critical for deployment on resource-constrained devices
reasoning.activation_memory_ratio: High ratio indicates memory bottleneck during training

trade_offs.depth_vs_width: Network has 2 hidden layers with max width 128. Deeper networks learn hierarchical features but are harder to train
trade_offs.regularization: Uses no regularization. Dropout/BatchNorm prevent overfitting but add computational cost
trade_offs.bottleneck: Bottleneck layer of size 64 forces dimensionality reduction, which can improve generalization but may lose information
